About Chef Blaze

With over a decade of culinary experience across Europe and beyond, Chef Blaze is a master of international cuisine, known for transforming global flavours into unforgettable dining experiences. Trained in traditional Italian and Mediterranean culinary techniques, Blaze brings creativity, precision, and passion to every plate. Whether crafting an elegant tasting menu or a vibrant fusion feast, his commitment to quality and storytelling through food sets him apart. Chef Blaze now offers bespoke private dining services, delivering restaurant-level sophistication in the comfort of your home.
